# Alibre Script API Text

This project is an LLM-friendly local reference for creating Alibre Design
scripts with IronPython 2.7.

## Primary Resources

- `alibre.script.api3.csv`: compact machine-readable API member list.
- `alibre.script.api2.csv`: larger machine-readable API member list.
- `alibre.script.api.txt`: full text API member list.
- `../alibre-script-examples/`: simple scripts by capability.
- `../alibre-script-library-examples/`: larger scripts with dialogs and utility workflows.
- `AGENTS.md`: rules for coding agents working in this repo.
- `docs/API-QUICK-REFERENCE.md`: curated signatures and examples.
- `docs/AGENT-WORKFLOWS.md`: repeatable workflows for script generation.
- `docs/PROMPT-TEMPLATES.md`: copy-ready prompts for LLM-assisted Alibre Script work.
- `docs/ECOSYSTEM-RESOURCE-MAP.md`: how to use sibling folders such as reflected output, stubs, and Code Assistant scripts.
- `docs/STUB-REVIEW.md`: correctness review and regeneration strategy for stubs.
- `docs/PACKAGE-USAGE.md`: how to install the generated stubs manually or package them for PyPI.
- `tools/audit_stubs.py`: read-only stub audit tool.
- `tools/generate_stubs.py`: creates `../Alibre-Script-Stub-Files/generated/AlibreScript.py` and `.pyi`.

## Sibling Workspace Resources

- `../Alibre-Script.Reflected/`: reflected per-class API source and generated Python-like output.
- `../Alibre-Script-Stub-Files/`: stubs and mocks for editor autocomplete/reference.
- `../Alibre-Script-Code-Assistant/`: AI-generated script examples to use as unverified seeds.

## Runtime Assumptions

- Language: IronPython 2.7 inside Alibre Script.
- Syntax: Python 2 compatible; avoid f-strings, annotations, and Python 3-only libraries.
- Geometry units: use the part/script units used by Alibre; angle values are degrees in the documented examples.
- Current script path globals: `ScriptFileName`, `ScriptFolder`.
- Active part access: `P = CurrentPart()`.
- Active assembly access: `A = CurrentAssembly()`.
- Open documents: `Parts = CurrentParts()`, `Assys = CurrentAssemblies()`.
- New part creation: `P = Part('Part Name')`.

## Common Retrieval Queries

```text
AddPlane angled plane axis angle
AddAxis two points planes faces
AddSketch AddRectangle AddCircle AddLine
AddExtrudeBoss AddExtrudeCut EndCondition DirectionType
WindowsInputTypes OptionsDialog UtilityDialog
ScriptFileName ScriptFolder CurrentPart CurrentAssembly CurrentParts CurrentAssemblies
GetPlane GetAxis GetPoint GetFace
Reflected sources output stubs mock_api Code Assistant
```

## Common Example Files

- Reference geometry: `../alibre-script-examples/Create-Reference-Planes-Axes-and-Points.py`
- Default datums: `../alibre-script-examples/Default-Reference-Geometry.py`
- Angled planes: `../alibre-script-examples/Mobius-Strip.py`
- Repeated angled planes: `../alibre-script-examples/Tool-Cutting.py`
- User input dialogs: `../alibre-script-examples/Getting-User-Input.py`
- Export workflows: `../alibre-script-library-examples/Import and Export/STL Exporter.py`
- Active-part workflows: `../alibre-script-library-examples/Mechanical/Gear Generator.py`
